overview-guide.text:
How this file is organised

1 Clickable prototype: press Play. The dark bar switches between Own domain, Bought domain and Console. Fail next check makes the next DNS check find nothing.

2 Setup flow: four rows, one per part of setup. Light boards on top, dark underneath.

3 Console: the shared app sections as rows. 03 Sharing and people and 06 Empty, loading and error states have nothing in v1; setup’s waiting and error screens are on page 2.

Board title: Admin / Section / Screen / Web, theme
Files: setup/<Screen>Web[Dark].dc.html and console/<Screen>Web[Dark].dc.html

The design system and onboarding live in the Yahel Design System file.
